name: Walmart
shortInfo: Manage items, orders, prices, promotions, inventory, and reports
brief: The Walmart Marketplace provides resources for sellers and suppliers to manage items, orders, prices, promotions, inventory and reports on Walmart.com. DataChannel’s Walmart Connector enables streaming relevant Walmart Marketplace data into a user determined warehouse. This sync happens in an automated manner after a user has configured relevant pipelines and determined an update frequency
about:
Onsite on our digital properties or offsite across the web and social channels, Walmart display ads deliver results you can measure - in our stores, too. Increase product sales and visibility and defend your market share with cost-effective ads that reach customers as they search and browse Walmart.  
  
Learn more about [Walmart API documentation.](https://www.walmart.com/)
availableData:
[Orders](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/walmart/pipelines/orders.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve detailed information of all the orders for specified search criteria.

[Reports](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/walmart/pipelines/reports.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve detailed information of all report requests for specified search criteria by using query parameters.

[Recon Reports](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/walmart/pipelines/recon_reports.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve detailed information of the reconciliation report for a specific date.

[Top Trending Items Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/walmart/pipelines/top_trending_items_report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve detailed information of the list of all the top trending items.

[Unpublished Items Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/walmart/pipelines/unpublished_items_report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve detailed information of the list of all the unpublished items.

[Seller Listing Quality Score](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/walmart/pipelines/seller_listing_quality_score.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve detailed information of the total listing quality score for a seller’s entire item catalog.

[Returns](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/walmart/pipelines/returns.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve detailed information of the details of return orders for the specified filter criteria.

Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/walmart/index.html) here.
